{{Quote|I'm raising funds for the Bakuran Loyalist Movement. We continue to put pressure on the government to sever ties with the Rebels and return to her true allegiance.|[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] in disguise to a [[Storinal]] customs officer|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bakuran Loyalist Movement''' was an organization created to convince the [[Bakuran Senate|senate]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] to leave the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and rejoin the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] disguised himself and pretended to be the exiled [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Iskit Tyestin]] of Bakura. His purported reason for visiting was to raise funds for the movement.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
